column4: Figures are based on general government expenditure on education from International Monetary Fund's World Economic Outlook Database.  Data prior to 2023 include Ministry of Education (MOE) and MOE Statutory Boards' expenditures, but excludes early childhood and pre-primary education expenditure under Early Childhood and Development Agency (ECDA).  Data from 2023 onwards, ECDA expenditure is included as part of education expenditure.

Figures are based on general government expenditure on health from International Monetary Fund's World Economic Outlook Database.  General government finance includes budgetary and extra-budgetary accounts.

Figures are based on general government expenditure on social protection from International Monetary Fund's World Economic Outlook Database.  General government finance includes budgetary and extra-budgetary accounts.
